_comment: STAGED frame-kernel frame-boundary hook wiring — NOT a live-harness edit. This fragment is the authoritative, PORTABLE shape of the `hooks` block that registers BOTH frame-kernel hooks: the SubagentStart auto-context handoff (loam-realignment SLICE 1a) and the SubagentStop out-of-band frame-consistency check (loam-realignment SLICE 1b). It is NOT merged automatically: per plan §7-4 the live activation (merge into a workspace's .claude/settings.json) is a GATED final step the dispatcher times, the same posture keep-pace's fragment uses; workspace-sync does NOT auto-compose fragments today (plan §7-5 / RF-1). Activation = merge this `hooks` block into the target .claude/settings.json (preserving any existing entries) and replace ${LOAM_REPO} with the absolute repo root (e.g. /Users/lukeivers/loam). Both hooks are fail-soft: SubagentStart exits 0 on every path and never blocks a subagent dispatch (AC.SACH.4 — a degraded bundle still lets the subagent start); SubagentStop exits 0 on every path and never blocks a subagent's return (AC.SSFC.5 — an off-frame result surfaces a NON-BLOCKING flag, never a hard abort).
